notes: Single source of truth for the crop-disease classifier. Read by AImodel/pipeline (split, verify, eval) and packages/ai (boot check, abstention). Changing this file changes the model contract: retrain, re-sync crop-knowledge.json, bump version.

notTrained.notes: In product scope but no usable training data. Always answered 'not sure'. The model has no class for these, so a photo of them can only be caught by the abstention rules; the eval OOD probe sets measure how often that works. Mango deferred 2026-09-28: the only usable source (MangoLeafBD) is CC BY-NC 3.0, not usable in a commercial product.

abstention.calibrationNote: Placeholders, deliberately conservative. evaluate.py sets these from the field-photo confidence curve; until then they must not be loosened.
